correctness.rationale: The 27 Picard classes give the line-intersection graph. Its triangles are tritangent plane triples: intersecting lines are coplanar in a triple, including concurrent triples since the tangent plane at their smooth common point contains all of them. For three disjoint tritangents, a conjugate tritangent contains one line from each; testing the conjugate triples directly gives exactly 120 nine-line supports with complementary partitions. Frobenius preserves the graph and thus these supports, with rationality of a configuration equivalent to setwise stability. Independently of the frozen reflection walk, each ordered sixer of skew lines determines at most one incidence automorphism: outside the six, each line has a unique incidence pattern with it, as seen from the listed L and Q classes. Exhaustion gives 72 sixers and all 720 orderings for each extend, with adjacency checked, so the graph automorphism action has exactly the known Weyl group order 51840. Taking the least orbit size on supports gives the claimed histogram; jointly testing fixed tritangents gives 12960. A geometric point in a Frobenius cycle of length h is rational over F_(q^n) iff h divides n, so least cycle size is precisely the minimal descent degree, not the splitting field degree. Banwait–Fité–Loughran Theorem 1.9 is unweighted for cubic surfaces and applies to this conjugacy-invariant event, yielding 1/4 asymptotically. In the sharpness construction, secants of the five conjugate conic points are nonrational since a rational secant would stabilize its two-point intersection with the conic. Each excludes at most one rational point outside the conic; q²−10>0 for q≥4, so the sixth point can be chosen off those secants and the conic. Bézout excludes any different conic through the five given points; the six centers are in general position. The blowup and anticanonical embedding descend and give the asserted five-cycle action, which has the claimed three profiles. Neither q=2 nor q=3 sharpness is asserted.
correctness.reproduction: python3 /workspace/reproductions/02_steiner.py constructs graph triangles and Steiner conjugate triples rather than repeating the uploaded support-multiplicity or reflection-walk algorithm, and exhausts 72×720 ordered sixers. It confirms 51840 elements, minimum counts 22752,6480,5760,6480,10368, event count 12960, 25 distinct combined cycle profiles and example profiles 1²5⁵, 5⁹, 5²⁴. These match verification_output.json lines 1–37. Frozen verify_steiner_frobenius.py was inspected, not executed. The finite exhaustion checks the actions; it is not a census of surfaces or a proof of geometric equidistribution.

value.rationale: The minimum extension degree is a natural, useful invariant of a rational marking, not another label of a Weyl class. The exhaustive result gives a sharp universal degree, explicit geometric examples at the bound, and a quarter-frequency mismatch between two standard cubic-surface markings. Knowing Frobenius class labels or line spectra alone does not give these exact results by a table read-off.
